description: Returns one page of an FAA document from Aviation Resources: an image of the whole page plus the full text of the passages on it. Use it after search_documents to read a page in full or to see figures, charts and tables, or to read on with nextPageNumber / previousPageNumber. Cite the page with its viewerUrl.

includeImage.description: Set false to get only the text, for example when reading through several pages.

pageNumber.description: 1-based page number in the PDF, as search_documents returns it (not the number printed on the page).

name: get_page

image.description: Describes the image content block (the whole page), or null when there is none.

imageUnavailableReason.description: Why image is null when an image was asked for.

indexed.description: False when the document has no text index yet; passages is then empty.

nextPageNumber.description: The page after, or null on the last page.

passages.description: Every indexed passage that covers this page, in document order.

pageEnd.description: Last page the passage covers; can be after pageNumber.

pageStart.description: First page the passage covers; can be before pageNumber.

previousPageNumber.description: The page before, or null on the first page.

id.description: UUID of the document. Pass it to get_page, or in resourceIds to search only this document.

viewerUrl.description: Opens this page in the Aviation Resources web app. Give this to the user as the source link.

title: Get Document Page
